output: Zaylo is a high-performance local AI inference engine and desktop studio designed for privacy-first AI workflows.

instruction: How do I start the server?
output: Navigate to the Server & API tab in the sidebar and click Start Server, or use the model quick-launch button.

instruction: Can I use Zaylo with LangChain or LlamaIndex?
output: Yes. Zaylo provides an OpenAI-compatible REST API at http://localhost:8080/v1 so any standard framework can connect immediately.

instruction: What fine-tuning methods are supported in Forge?
output: Forge currently supports parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA), with automated hyperparameter selection and hardware profiling.
